zh.title: 紐幾內亞航空 Fokker 100 在瓦尼莫中止起飛 調查機關評估是否立案
zh.summary: 紐幾內亞航空 PX141 航班11月21日在瓦尼莫機場起飛滾行前發動機推力異常，機組在極低速時中止起飛。巴布亞紐幾內亞事故調查委員會正評估是否展開獨立調查。
body: 《The Aviation Herald》報導，紐幾內亞航空一架 Fokker 100 於11月21日準備執飛瓦尼莫往韋瓦克的 PX141 航班。飛機在瓦尼莫機場12跑道加大推力準備起飛時，其中一具發動機伴隨連串異響、推力下降，回升後又再度下降。機組在極低速時中止起飛，飛機隨後返回停機坪。涉事飛機註冊號為 P2-ANH。
巴布亞紐幾內亞事故調查委員會（AIC）表示，正評估這起與發動機有關的中止起飛事件，以決定是否有必要展開獨立安全調查；若不立案，將移交該國民航安全主管機關（CASA PNG）進行監理安全評估與後續處理。
發動機異常的原因仍待確認。

en.title: Air Niugini Fokker 100 rejects takeoff at Vanimo; investigators assess the occurrence
en.summary: Air Niugini flight PX141 rejected takeoff at very low speed at Vanimo on November 21 after an engine problem. Papua New Guinea's Accident Investigation Commission is assessing whether to open an independent investigation.
body: The Aviation Herald reported that an Air Niugini Fokker 100 was preparing to operate flight PX141 from Vanimo to Wewak on November 21. As the engines were accelerating for takeoff from Vanimo's runway 12, one engine rolled back with a series of chattering sounds, accelerated again and then rolled back a second time. The crew rejected the takeoff at very low speed and the aircraft returned to the apron. The aircraft was registered P2-ANH.

Papua New Guinea's Accident Investigation Commission (AIC) said it is assessing the reported engine-related aborted takeoff to determine whether an independent safety investigation is warranted. If not, the matter will be referred to CASA PNG for regulatory safety assessment and follow-up.
The cause of the engine problem has not been established.

facts.claim: Air Niugini Fokker 100 P2-ANH, flight PX141 from Vanimo to Wewak, rejected takeoff at very low speed on November 21 after an engine rolled back twice.
The AIC is assessing whether an independent safety investigation is warranted; otherwise the matter goes to CASA PNG.
